name: Ram 1500 TRX
h1: Ram 1500 TRX: performance, engines and what owners say

nhtsa.note: NHTSA files the TRX under Ram 1500, so these counts are every Ram 1500 of these years.

gens.tag: 702 hp Hellcat V-8, long-travel suspension, 35-inch tires.

trans.note: TorqueFlite 8HP95; BorgWarner 48-13 active transfer case with 2.64:1 low range

weight.note: Car and Driver's 2021 test truck; their 2022 long-term truck weighed 6,781 lb

variants.name: Ram 1500 TRX Launch Edition
variants.what: 702 trucks: Anvil Gray paint, special console badge, Level 2 Equipment Group, carbon trim, head-up display, beadlock-capable wheels.

variants.name: Ram 1500 TRX Final Edition
variants.what: Up to 4,000 trucks: three new colors, Satin Titanium beadlock-capable wheels, build-number console badge, matte carbon trim.

hellcat.name: Hellcat 6.2 supercharged HEMI
facts: 702 hp at 6,100 rpm, 650 lb-ft at 4,800 rpm (Ram TRX)
2.38-liter twin-screw, up to 11.6 psi, twin charge air coolers on their own cooling loop
Cast-iron block, forged steel crank, forged pistons, powder-forged rods
Rear-sump pan with baffles for off-road angles, external oil cooler

issues.x: Worn supercharger front bearings cause noise and can damage the rotors and the drive coupler pins, an enthusiast magazine reports for the 6.2 HEMI.
issues.fix: Replacing the four front bearings fixes nearly all of the noise.

issues.t: Catalytic converter and O2 sensors (one test truck)
issues.x: Car and Driver's 2022 TRX threw a check-engine light late in its 40,000-mile test. It needed a new right-side catalytic converter and two oxygen sensors.
issues.fix: The dealer replaced them at no charge.

issues.t: No engine recall on the TRX
issues.x: NHTSA's 2021–2024 Ram 1500 recall list has no recall for the supercharged 6.2. The engine recalls on these years cover the 3.0 diesel and the 5.7 eTorque.
